Subject: Deployment path & cost sketches — BluePeak next steps

Hi Alex / Samir —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a set of lightweight cost sketches so we can pick the right pilot path. I copied Marissa and Karthik to own pricing and technical sizing next steps.

Call summary (what we heard)
- Primary workload: multi-turn customer support assistant + nightly batch embeddings for search.
- Latency requirement: 200–400ms p95 for chat front-end.
- Data residency: US only, some data must remain in customer VPC for PII workflows.
- Current traffic (est): ~1.2B generation tokens/mo and ~250M embedding tokens/mo with spikes during business hours.
- Security gating: SOC 2 + KMS integration + audit logs required for procurement.

High-level deployment options (sketch):
1) Hosted API (fastest): usage-based per-token billing, no infra ops for BluePeak. Good for validating UX and early traffic.
2) Dedicated (reserved capacity): committed monthly capacity (GPU pools) with lower per-token unit economics at scale and deterministic latency. Requires 3–6 month commit typically.
3) Private (VPC / on-prem): for full network isolation and KMS/HSM control. Higher up-front platform fee and longer lead time.

Preliminary cost sketches (ballpark numbers to guide choice) — full workbook attached. These are rough and will be refined with Karthik/Marissa.
- Hosted API: ~$0.00055 / gen token (model X variant), embeddings ~$0.0009 / token. Projected monthly spend: ~$700k at current estimate.
- Dedicated reserved ask: example 6‑node GPU pool + 20% burst = ~$28k / month base commit (6-month term) + ~10% ops surcharge; break-even vs hosted at ~2.5B gen tokens/mo (assumes similar model profile).
- Private VPC (customer-managed instances): platform license + deployment support = one-time onboarding fees (~$120k) + monthly platform support (~$8k) while infra costs billed separately or self-managed.

Attachments: BluePeak_cost_scenarios_v1.xlsx (summary & sensitivity) and pilot-MAP-template.docx (mutual action plan draft).

Immediate next steps we propose:
- Quick model run with your real traffic sample (Karthik) — can we get anonymized token distribution and 7 days of peak hour traffic?
- Procurement checklist (Marissa) — I’ll share an MSAs/SLAs starter and SOC 2 evidence pack.
- If committed path looks attractive, propose a 3–month pilot commit that we can upgrade to Dedicated at month 4.

Would Monday or Tuesday next week work for a short pricing calibration call?

Thanks,
Vanessa

Thanks Vanessa — this is helpful. A few clarifying questions before we schedule the follow-up: 

1) SOC 2 / KMS: Can the hosted option support customer-managed KMS for keys used to encrypt persisted data? If not, what are the minimum requirements for the private option?
2) Break-even math: your break-even callout (~2.5B tokens) — can you show the assumptions (model mix, avg tokens/response, peak concurrency) that feed that?
3) Egress / network: for embeddings and nightly batch pulls we will have significant egress — are those charged separately on top of the per-token rates? How do you handle traffic that leaves a VPC?
4) SLA/Support: We need a target 99.9% uptime SLA for production + a runbook for incident escalation. Is that part of Dedicated or an add-on?

If you can send a short follow-up with the assumptions and a short sensitivity table we can review internally. Tentatively we can do Tuesday 11/24 @ 10am PT for the pricing calibration.

Alex — thanks for the precise asks. Below are the assumptions that feed the break-even and a short sensitivity view (pulled from the attached workbook). I’ll bring Karthik into the Tuesday call to walk infra sizing.

Assumptions for the ballpark math
- Model mix: 70% gen calls (model-X-v1), 30% embeddings (embed-Y).
- Avg tokens per gen response: 150 tokens.
- Peak concurrency: 380 RPS sustained across peak window.
- Hosted baseline rates used: $0.00055 / gen-token; $0.0009 / embed-token.
- Dedicated commit: $28k / month covers GPU pool + runtime license; ops surcharge assumed 10% for monitoring/trace retention. Additional per-token compute beyond pool capacity billed at reduced per-token rate.
- Egress/network: outbound network egress is a pass-through item for Private and Dedicated (varies by customer region/cloud). Hosted bundle includes 10TB outbound / month; additional egress billed at cost + 5%.

Sensitivity highlights (see workbook for full table)
- If avg tokens/response rises to 225, hosted cost increases ~35% and break-even moves to ~1.9B tokens/mo for Dedicated.
- Adding strict KMS + HSM for hosted (customer-managed key) increases hosted engineering surcharge (~$3k/mo) vs Private where customer controls keys.

Answers to your direct questions
1) Hosted + customer-managed KMS: we support BYOK in our hosted plane for persisted model outputs and stored artifacts via integrations with AWS KMS/GCP KMS; for HSM-backed keys we recommend Private deployment.
2) Break-even workbook attached (BluePeak_cost_scenarios_v1.xlsx) — main levers: tokens/mo, avg tokens/resp, model selection, and commit term.
3) Egress: treated as a separate line item for Dedicated/Private; included up to a capped amount in hosted. We’ll provide a sample egress charge table based on your expected nightly batch size.
4) SLA: 99.9% SLA is available for Dedicated as part of our enterprise tier; Hosted can offer a 99.5% standard SLA. Runbook and escalation paths are included in the Dedicated onboarding packet.

Next steps I’ll take before Tue 11/24 call:
- Karthik: run the sample traffic through the sizing model (can we get a 7-day anonymized sample? ideally compressed CSV).
- Marissa: prepare procurement starter with MSA and SOC 2 pack.
- I’ll surface two pricing scenarios for the call: (A) 3‑month pilot commit -> Dedicated conversion path, (B) Hosted + usage with 6‑month review.

Call confirmed tentatively Tue 11/24 @ 10am PT — I’ll send calendar invite pending your confirmation.

Best,
Vanessa
